comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This is one of only three items in the game which can possess the Age effect (18th century) EX Effect. It requires the following base item: Kaftan

In addition, you must have obtained either the Transmutation Alchemy Equipment or Complex Alchemy Equipment furniture for your quarters, and have finished the Egypt and Atlantis quest.

Required skills:

Alchemy r6
Sewing r13

Ingredients: Orichalcum x1 + Check (10 million㌦) x5 + Special Purchase Bond x5

Be careful. As with all transmutation alchemy production, you run the risk of losing your ingredients and ending up with nothing unless you use a Book of Uroboros to guarantee the recipe's success. Cheers.
